title: Payroll Processing Manual
subtitle: Employment Hero Payroll  ·  Fortnightly cycle  ·  Complete series
intro: Payroll at CTS runs on a fortnightly cycle. This manual covers that cycle end to end, from collecting payroll notes through to uploading the payment file and filing the records.
The eight parts are also published as standalone guides, so a new starter can be given only the sections that apply to them. Both are generated from the same source, so they always agree.

Reconciliation is split three ways because the rules differ by employment type. Check an employee's type before applying any rule; the same hours are treated differently for a casual and a salaried employee.
